# TurkishExporter.Net

> > Turkey's largest export gateway connecting international buyers with Turkish manufacturers and exporters across industrial, consumer, and agricultural sectors.

TurkishExporter.Net serves as a comprehensive B2B platform showcasing Turkish export companies ranging from ISO 9001 certified manufacturers to specialized suppliers. The platform features exporters from Istanbul, Bursa, Konya, and other Turkish industrial hubs, offering products from PVC profiles and agricultural machinery to textiles, pet products, and hotel equipment.

## Key Topics

- Turkish exporters
- Turkey manufacturing
- ISO 9001 certified companies
- Istanbul industrial zone
- B2B export platform
- Agricultural machinery
- Textile manufacturing
- PVC and polymer products
- Baby and hygiene products
- Automotive spare parts
- Food processing equipment
- Building materials
- Pet products and supplies
- Hotel and hospitality equipment
- Water treatment systems

- [ALPTAR TARIM - Agricultural Machinery](https://www.turkishexporter.net/ar/companies/alptar-tarim-makinalari-a-s_N382701): Agricultural machinery including manure spreaders & balers
